name: Christmas Tree
overview: Scripture references trees and boughs in various contexts, such as the rejoicing with branches of goodly trees commanded in Leviticus 23:40, and the imagery of the Branch from the stem of Jesse in Isaiah 11:1, symbolizing Christ. However, Jeremiah 3:6 warns against idolatrous practices involving green trees, highlighting the danger of turning away from God through pagan customs. While the Bible records the use of tree branches in worship and celebration, it also cautions believers to maintain purity in their devotion, pointing ultimately to Christ as the true fulfillment of the tree imagery.
